# Delta: cursor/delegate-sweep-7203 — make the legacy path read-free and self-healing (same branch, on top)

Driver review of head 3d461512f1 (your #7203 fix). Both halves are correct and stay. One residual makes the
fix incomplete on THIS machine: every existing lease dir (25 today) has no marker, so
`_build_runtime_tmp_legacy_lease_index` runs on every dispatch and calls `_read_state_json` on all
~2,000 records (4.8 GB, 30+ MB each) — once per sweep instead of 25×, but still tens of seconds per
dispatch, and forever, because nothing ever writes the marker for a legacy lease.

Facts you can rely on: `_runtime_tmp_lease_name(task_id)` is a pure sanitization of the task id
(`scripts/delegate.py:680-682`), and task records are named `batch_state/tasks/<task_id>.json`.

## Outcome
A sweep over legacy leases opens ZERO task records in the common case, and a legacy lease is resolved at
most once in its lifetime.

## Do
1. Build the legacy index from record filename STEMS: `lease_name(stem) → stem`, no JSON reads. Only if
   a legacy lease name is absent from that stem index, fall back to the existing bounded one-pass read —
   and keep that fallback bounded to the unresolved leases, never all leases.
2. When a legacy lease is resolved by either path, BACKFILL its `.delegate-task-id` marker so the next
   sweep takes the O(1) path. Never write into a lease dir the sweep is about to remove.
3. Extend `tests/test_delegate_runtime_tmp_sweep.py`: (a) legacy leases whose task ids exist as records →
   zero `_read_state_json` calls (counting monkeypatch), mutation-check by removing the stem index;
   (b) after one sweep the marker exists and a second sweep is O(1) even with the fallback disabled.

  tests/test_delegate_readonly_guard.py tests/test_delegate.py` green; ruff clean on changed files.
- Both mutation checks quoted (revert → fail, restore → pass).
- One conventional commit on top (`fix(delegate): read-free legacy lease index with marker backfill (#7203)`,
  X-Agent trailer). NO push, NO amend, NO rebase, NO auto-merge. Report new HEAD SHA + evidence.

another branch; do not restructure those regions.

I'll start with cold start, then inspect the delegate sweep and legacy lease indexing code to implement read-free indexing with marker backfill.

Legacy lease resolution is now read-free in the common case, with marker backfill for kept leases.

**HEAD:** `60062058f24bdca231e7e1f4e80bfc93f1b387fc`

### Changes

1. **`_build_runtime_tmp_legacy_stem_index()`** — maps `lease_name(stem) → stem` from `*.json` filenames only; no JSON reads.
2. **`_read_runtime_tmp_state_for_legacy_lease()`** — stem-index lookup first; bounded per-lease scan only when the stem index misses.
3. **Marker backfill** — when a marker-less lease is resolved and kept (non-terminal or live PID), writes `.delegate-task-id` before continuing; skipped for leases about to be reaped.
